subject.title: fix(searxng): fail closed on unresolved base url refs

question: When `plugins.entries.searxng.config.webSearch.baseUrl` is explicitly configured but cannot resolve, should OpenClaw fail with a configuration error or continue using ambient `SEARXNG_BASE_URL`?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility and availability policy change, not a mechanical correctness question: either behavior can be coherent, but existing deployments may rely on the fallback.

options.title: Approve fail-closed behavior
options.body: Land the PR and make explicit unavailable or invalid configuration block search requests rather than silently redirecting them to an ambient endpoint.

options.title: Preserve ambient compatibility
options.body: Keep the current fallback behavior unless and until a documented migration or opt-in strict mode is approved.

recommendation.title: Preserve ambient compatibility
recommendation.body: Keep the current fallback behavior unless and until a documented migration or opt-in strict mode is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The discussion directly asks this person to decide the SearXNG compatibility contract, and no contrary maintainer decision is visible.
